implementation: Original ElnProbe peripheral with nine methods: signalSetDir/GetDir/SetOut/GetOut/GetIn, wirelessSet/Remove/RemoveAll/Get. Six independent 0.05-ohm, current-limited gates fixed to world XN/XP/YN/YP/ZN/ZP, initially high impedance, saved modes/outputs. Added native computer_probe block namespace rather than colliding with the existing energy-converter single-block identity. Full solid cube, immutable 15-light blocking and six original fixed textures; world lighting samples each exposed neighbor rather than dark cube center.

actualLua: Real CC computer booted the authored startup.lua. It discovered the actual Forge peripheral, called all nine methods, read real input voltage, drove a real resistor and wireless receiver, rejected NaN, checked real max/min transmitters, reattached after actual probe NBT reload, confirmed saved output, then removed radio channels and opened the real output. Independent native six-input fixture checks all physical sides without sharing source wires at outside corners.
